title: The Lost Horizon
author: Marguerite Joubert
blurb: Mara Marchetti, a desert ranger tracking a thief across nothing, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. Then the tide reveals a cave that legends charge admission to — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must beat the salvage fleet to the wreck by six tides, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
